title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations on Lake Street, Memorial Highway, Gerald Avenue, and Yalick Plaza in the Dallas-area orbit of Misericordia University.

cards.title: Pizza Bella – Dallas
cards.subtitle: Lake Street corridor • 31 Lake Street
cards.notes: Use this Lake Street stop when you want a clearly identified pizza option; confirm current service details directly with the restaurant before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza destination on the Lake Street approach to Dallas.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Bella’s official Dallas page lists its location at 31 Lake Street, Dallas, PA.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily hours; check it for current availability.

cards.title: Bagel Art
cards.subtitle: Memorial Highway corridor • Dallas Shopping Center
cards.notes: Plan a bakery or catering pickup along Memorial Highway; the official shop page identifies Dallas Shopping Center and lists platter categories.
cards.short_summary: A bakery counter on the Memorial Highway commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Bagel Art’s official site lists its Dallas location at 62 Memorial Highway in Dallas Shopping Center and shows bakery platter offerings.
cards.access_notes: Check the shop site or contact the business for current pickup details.

cards.title: CK's Cantina & Grill
cards.subtitle: Gerald Avenue corridor • 63 Gerald Avenue
cards.notes: Use Gerald Avenue for a sit-down food option; review the restaurant’s posted menu and daily hours before making plans with a group.
cards.short_summary: A named Mexican-food destination beside the Dallas commercial streets.
cards.evidence_claim: CK's official menu page identifies CK's Cantina & Grill at 63 Gerald Avenue, Dallas, and posts its menu and hours.
cards.source_title: CK's Dallas PA Cantina & Grill – Menus
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours are Sunday closed and Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Prime at City Market
cards.subtitle: Memorial Highway corridor • 2161 Memorial Highway
cards.notes: Put this Memorial Highway address on a meal-planning route; the restaurant publishes separate dinner and brunch periods on its contact page.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant address on the central Memorial Highway run.
cards.evidence_claim: Prime at City Market’s official contact page lists 2161 Memorial Highway, Dallas, and publishes dinner and brunch hours.
cards.source_title: Prime at City Market – Contact Us
cards.access_notes: The official page lists different hours by day, including Friday–Sunday brunch; check for updates.

cards.title: Di Ferro's
cards.subtitle: Memorial Highway corridor • 2587 Memorial Highway
cards.notes: Choose this Memorial Highway address for pizza, sandwiches, or wings; its official page names these food categories and gives visiting information.
cards.short_summary: An Italian-food stop on Memorial Highway.
cards.evidence_claim: Di Ferro’s official about page lists 2587 Memorial Highway, Dallas, and describes pizza, sandwiches, and wings.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 4–9:30 p.m.; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's – 2685 Memorial Highway
cards.subtitle: Memorial Highway corridor • 2685 Memorial Highway
cards.notes: Use this address for a quick food stop along Memorial Highway; the location page confirms breakfast, mobile ordering, Wi-Fi, and restaurant hours.
cards.short_summary: A nationally operated quick-service destination with a verified Dallas address.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists 2685 Memorial Highway, Dallas, and identifies breakfast, mobile ordering, mobile payment, and Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service daily from 6:30 a.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Bernie's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Memorial Highway corridor • 3281 Memorial Highway
cards.notes: Add this address to a Memorial Highway food route if takeout suits the plan; the business identifies itself as takeout only and posts hours.
cards.short_summary: A takeout pizza destination farther along Memorial Highway.
cards.evidence_claim: Bernie’s Pizza’s official site lists 3281 Memorial Highway, Dallas, and says the business is takeout only.
cards.access_notes: The official site posts Wednesday–Saturday hours and limited Sunday football-season hours; verify before going.

cards.title: Back Mountain Bowl
cards.subtitle: Memorial Highway corridor • 3555 Memorial Highway
cards.notes: Use this Memorial Highway destination for bowling and arcade activity; reserve or call ahead, especially for groups and changing holiday schedules.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated bowling alley with an arcade and dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: Back Mountain Bowl’s official site lists 3555 Memorial Highway, Dallas, and identifies 16 bowling lanes, an arcade, and a dining room.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day; the official site directs visitors to its news and events information for holiday hours.

cards.title: Burrito Loco Mexican Grill – Dallas
cards.subtitle: Yalick Plaza corridor • 3808 Yalick Plaza
cards.notes: Use the Yalick Plaza address for Mexican food; the restaurant’s own location page provides Dallas service hours and direct contact information.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant destination in Yalick Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Burrito Loco’s official site lists its Dallas location at 3808 Yalick Plaza and identifies it as a Mexican restaurant.
cards.access_notes: The official location page posts daily business hours; confirm them before visiting.

cards.title: Grotto Pizza
cards.subtitle: Route 415 corridor • Harveys Lake
cards.notes: Follow Route 415 toward Harveys Lake for this named pizza destination; Misericordia’s parent resource includes Grotto Pizza among local places to eat.
cards.short_summary: A university-listed local food option on the Route 415/Harveys Lake direction.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia University’s Parents & Families page includes Grotto Pizza in its list of local places to eat.
cards.access_notes: Consult the business directly for its current address, hours, and service options.
